messages:
jordan_sales: Heads-up — PetraTech POC ready to sign. Procurement insists on one signature on the OF but needs billing from Redwood Inference EU. They pushed DPA redlines and added an SLA clause. Can we do cross-entity billing without re-issuing the MSA? @maria_legal @kevin_finance

maria_legal: Short answer: possible but we need an addendum. Long answer: MSA should ideally match the billing/legal entity. If PetraTech requires Redwood EU on invoices, we can sign the OF as Redwood EU and attach the MSA via an assignment or linking addendum. Need to surface indemnity and governing law implications.

jordan_sales: PetraTech prefers not to re-sign an entire MSA — they'll only sign an OF. They sent a PO referencing the existing MSA (US entity). They're ok with an addendum. Timeline: want signed by Wed.

kevin_finance: Finance check: if billing = EU entity, invoices must use EU bank, show VAT number, and be in EUR. We also need SWIFT/IBAN details and their PO number on invoice. Treasury prefers net30 but can accept net15 for POCs with exec approval. Confirm currency and VAT.

lina_solutions: From delivery side: POC is hosted, no data residency concerns. We can start on infra once the OF is executed. If we do a cross-entity addendum, please include a single point of contact for billing disputes.

maria_legal: I'll draft a 1-page addendum: - identify Redwood Inference EU LLC as billing counterparty on OF - confirm that MSA terms apply to the OF - limited cross-entity indemnity statement - E-sign acceptance clause. Will circulate redline for quick sig.

jordan_sales: Awesome. PetraTech's PO: PT-4589, VAT ESX99887766, currency EUR, wants invoice to "Redwood Inference EU LLC". They asked about signed DPA and whether it needs EU controller language.

maria_legal: DPA: switch controller/processor language to note EU jurisdiction. Minor redlines only. Addendum will reference DPA version as well so all aligned. Also need KYC docs from PetraTech (Certificate of Incorporation).

kevin_finance: Please confirm billing contact and send the provisional invoice once EM entity is set. I'll pre-approve EUR wiring instructions. Also, flagging month-end close on Friday — need executed docs by Thu COB to process payment in this cycle.

jordan_sales: Getting KYC now. Routing the addendum + redlined OF to PetraTech for e-sign. Can we use our standard e-sign vendor and have a single signature page that binds both documents? @ops-signing-bot

ops-signing-bot: ops-signing-bot: E-sign flow available. Recommend: single envelope with OF + 1-page addendum + DPA signature block. Audit trail included. For cross-entity signatures, include explicit "Entity executing this Agreement" lines. Will provide template.

maria_legal: Thanks. I'll include the explicit entity lines and a short note: "Execution by the designated Redwood Inference entity is sufficient for billing purposes only; contractual obligations follow the MSA." That should appease procurement.

jordan_sales: Great — routing now. Will update when PetraTech signs. If anyone needs to review the exact phrasing before send, ping me in thread. :thumbsup:
